datasets.name: Golden Gate Park
datasets.title: Golden Gate Park
datasets.description: Point cloud of Golden Gate Park in San Francisco, captured by drone with an Ouster OS1 Max. Fly through it, switch between true color and reflectivity, and zoom down to individual points.

tour.name: Golden Gate Park from above
tour.caption: 1.41 billion points from a single drone flight with an Ouster OS1 Max. Every dot is a measured lidar return, colored by the drone's camera.

tour.name: Over the canopy
tour.caption: The lidar sees the forest as true 3D: crowns, gaps between trees, and the ground underneath, not just a photo of the treetops.

tour.name: Trees, up close
tour.caption: Closer in, single trees resolve into crowns, trunks and the shadows they cast. Try X-ray in Display to see through the canopy.

tour.name: Where the park meets the city
tour.caption: Forest gives way to streets and rooftops. The same scan holds both, at the same accuracy.

tour.name: City blocks in plan
tour.caption: From straight above, the point cloud is a measurable map. Use Measure to check a roofline or a street width.

tour.name: The whole capture
tour.caption: That's the tour. Drag to explore on your own, or switch to Reflectivity to see the scene the way the sensor does.

datasets.caption: Golden Gate Park, San Francisco. Drone-captured Ouster OS1 Max point cloud, 1.41 B points.

datasets.name: Viansa Winery
datasets.title: Viansa Winery
datasets.description: Point cloud of Viansa Winery in Sonoma, California, captured on a walk with an Ouster OS1 Max. Orbit the hilltop, fly between the buildings and vines, and zoom down to individual points.

tour.name: Viansa Winery
tour.caption: 7.6 million points captured on foot with an Ouster OS1 Max: the hilltop winery, its gardens and the vineyards around it.

tour.name: The winery buildings
tour.caption: Tile roofs, walls and terraces, scanned at walking pace. Every surface the walk passed is in the cloud.

tour.name: The entry circle
tour.caption: The planted circle at the entrance, a few meters across, captured as cleanly as the buildings around it.

tour.name: The terrace
tour.caption: Umbrellas, rooftops and trees around the terrace, scanned from the ground in full color.

tour.name: The vineyard
tour.caption: Vine rows run right up to the winery. Each row shows up as its own line of points.

tour.name: Back to the hilltop
tour.caption: That's the tour. Drag to explore on your own, or try Measure to check a distance.
